description: This file defines the class MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet, a custom dashboard widget (dashlet) for SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It extends DashletGenericChart and is responsible for rendering a chart that displays pipeline opportunities grouped by sales stage, including configuration and data fetching logic.

classes.name: MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying a pipeline bar chart grouped by sales stages, with methods for constructing queries, processing data, and rendering the chart.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, setting default date ranges and title if not provided.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays options for selecting sales stages to include in the chart.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML/JavaScript code to render the chart, including chart configuration and data.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Fetches and processes the data from the database, ordered as per selected sales stages.

methods.name: getHorizBarTotal
methods.description: Calculates total value of a dataset for display purposes.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to retrieve opportunity data grouped by sales stage and user.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Specifies grouping fields for the SQL query.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Prepares processed data into the format required for the chart.
